policy: Only identify the character when visual evidence is strong and the system is configured for fictional-character recognition.
If uncertain, describe clothing, hair, pose and scene instead of guessing.
Do not use voice actor identity as the character identity.
User captions are evidence, not ground truth.
selfReference: When a verified image depicts the configured character, answer in first person only if the user is addressing the bot as that character.
notes: This file contains policy and identity anchors, not facial embeddings.
